steps.code:
# Process remaining songs: search, find exact match, and add to playlist
playlist_id = playlist_resp['playlist_id']
access_token = spotify_login['access_token']

for line in lines[1:]:
    parts = line.split(' by ')
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists_str = parts[1].strip()
    artists_list = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
    # Search for the song
    search_result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=access_token)
    # Find exact match
    match = None
    for song in search_result:
        if song['title'] == title:
            song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
            if all(artist in song_artists for artist in artists_list):
                match = song
                break
    if match:
        add_result = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=match['song_id'], access_token=access_token)
        print(f"Added: {title} -> {add_result}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")
